note: Print Your Own's parts list, as a content pack (the same shape calendar.json uses). Every entry is a real part generated from Nimrod's build123d sources, with its 3D model (GLB) beside it; nothing is placeholder geometry. The full brick list, with sizes and triangle counts, is /design-assets/bricks/bricks.json.

parts.title: Brick 40 x 40 x 40
parts.summary: 40 x 40 x 40 mm, 1 cell of the 40 mm grid. A 10 mm socket sits in the middle of every 40 mm square on every face (6 sockets), each one a straight bore through the brick. Fits a 256 mm print bed.

parts.title: L-bracket 40
parts.summary: Two 40 x 40 mm arms at a right angle, 5 mm thick, with a gusset in the corner and a socket every 40 mm. Braces the inside corner between two bricks.

parts.title: L-bracket 80
parts.summary: Two 80 x 40 mm arms at a right angle, 5 mm thick, with a gusset in the corner and a socket every 40 mm. Braces the inside corner between two bricks.

parts.title: L-bracket 120
parts.summary: Two 120 x 40 mm arms at a right angle, 5 mm thick, with a gusset in the corner and a socket every 40 mm. Braces the inside corner between two bricks.

parts.title: L-bracket 160
parts.summary: Two 160 x 40 mm arms at a right angle, 5 mm thick, with a gusset in the corner and a socket every 40 mm. Braces the inside corner between two bricks.

parts.title: 3-way corner bracket
parts.summary: Three 40 x 40 mm panels meeting at a corner, one socket each, with a gusset along every inside edge. Braces the corner where three brick faces meet.

parts.title: Straight joiner plate 80 x 40
parts.summary: A straight strip of 40 mm squares, 80 x 40 x 5 mm, one socket per square. Lies flat on brick faces and ties two bricks together across a seam.

parts.title: Flat corner plate 80 x 80
parts.summary: A flat corner of 40 mm squares, 80 x 80 x 5 mm, one socket per square. Lies flat on brick faces and ties a corner of bricks together.

parts.title: Straight joiner plate 120 x 40
parts.summary: A straight strip of 40 mm squares, 120 x 40 x 5 mm, one socket per square. Lies flat on brick faces and ties two bricks together across a seam.

parts.title: T plate 120 x 80
parts.summary: A flat T of 40 mm squares, 120 x 80 x 5 mm, one socket per square. Lies flat on brick faces and ties a T-junction of bricks together.

parts.title: Desk
parts.summary: A 1280 x 640 x 760 mm desk made only of the parts above: 24 bricks, 6 L-brackets and 2 corner brackets, held by 196 connector pins. Its long bricks are bigger than a print bed, so it is a virtual build for now: the first piece of furniture made of Nimrod bricks.
